name: Wide Ken
description: Widen the sensing ring until it takes in a whole courtyard of living souls at once.

name: Crowd Hark
description: Pick the single loudest soul out of a gathered crowd and follow it.

name: Soul Tally
description: Count every soul inside the widened ring in one quick pass.

name: Ring Hold
description: Keep the widened ring steady against drift so that it does not thin at the edges.

name: Stray Turn
description: Turn a stray soul touch off its line before it reaches the user's mind.

name: Loose Net
description: Cast a loose net of soul over a wide space and feel anything living that brushes its cords.

name: Soul Rinse
description: Rinse one ally's soul of the bruising and haze that long strain has left behind.

name: Many Mind
description: Hold five separate souls in mind at one time and keep each one's place straight.

name: Order Mark
description: Rank the souls in view by weight so that the strongest is named at once.

name: Strand Split
description: Split the user's attention into strands so that each strand follows its own soul.

name: Noise Fold
description: Fold the clamour of a crowd's souls into a low hum so that the mind stays clear.

name: Friend Pick
description: Pick one friend's soul out of a crowd of strangers by its familiar weight.

name: Crowd Prick
description: Drive a thin point of soul through the crowd's noise to sting one chosen foe.

name: Weighed Look
description: Weigh every soul in view against the user's own and name which are greater and which lesser.

name: Haze Lift
description: Clear the dazed fog that a crowd's noise leaves in one ally's mind.

name: Thread Fan
description: Fan out a handful of thin threads of soul and learn what each one touches.

name: Weft Start
description: Cross the thin threads one over another to begin a steady cloth of awareness.

name: Cloth Settle
description: Smooth the woven cloth so that it carries finer feeling to the user.

name: Strand Tug
description: Tug a foe's own sensing thread hard so that the foe's attention snaps away from the user.

name: Frayed Guard
description: Let loose threads trail from the mind so that an enemy touch tangles in them and slows.

name: Woven Sense
description: Spread the woven cloth over a wide ground so that any step upon it is felt at once.

name: Knot Undo
description: Undo a knot of soul force that a clumsy sensing art has tangled in one ally's mind.

name: Past Reach
description: Let the soul pass through a closed door and feel who stands on the far side.

name: Plank Feel
description: Feel through a wooden panel and learn whether anything living leans against it.

name: Stone Depth
description: Learn how thick a stone barrier runs by how much the sensing soul thins inside it.

name: Cloth Look
description: Look through hanging cloth or canvas and count the souls that wait behind it.

name: Seam Probe
description: Slip a point of soul through a seam in a barrier to sting a foe who thinks himself hidden.

name: Seam Close
description: Seal every seam of the user's own soul so that nothing can slip through from outside.

name: Behind Count
description: Count and place every soul behind a barrier and mark which are armed in spirit.

name: Hidden Trace
description: Find a soul that is hiding by art and mark where it crouches.

name: Warding Read
description: Read the soul that a warding holds and learn what it was made to guard.

name: Mind Shutter
description: Close a shutter over the mind so that hostile souls find only a flat surface.

name: Narrow Gap
description: Open the shutter a finger wide to take in friendly souls and keep hostile ones out.

name: Friend Sort
description: Sort the souls in reach into those that wish the user well and those that do not.

name: Hostile Flag
description: Raise a plain flag in the mind over any soul that turns hostile within reach.

name: Quick Latch
description: Snap the shutter closed on a sudden soul touch and let the touch glance away.

name: Shut Mind
description: Hold the whole mind shut as one closed room against soul pressure that lasts a full minute.

name: Weight Ease
description: Ease the lingering ache that long soul pressure leaves in one ally's mind.

name: Far Spark
description: Fling a spark of soul to a far point and learn what stands near where it lands.

name: Lantern Throw
description: Throw a lantern of soul across a wide field and read the souls it lights.

name: Lantern Tether
description: Tie the thrown lantern to the user by a cord so that it can be drawn home without loss.

name: Distant Count
description: Count the souls gathered at a far place and mark the nearest.

name: Cord Tighten
description: Tighten the cord to the far lantern so that its light does not flicker.

name: Far Dim
description: Dim the far lantern at once so that watchers at that place do not feel it.

name: Far Place
description: Show a far place as a plain picture in the user's mind with every soul in it marked.

name: Lantern Recall
description: Call the far lantern home at once and read everything it brushed on the way.

name: Under Face
description: Read the deeper feeling that lies under a stranger's face and speech.

name: Grief Weight
description: Feel the slow heavy drag of grief in a soul and learn who in reach is mourning.

name: Glad Warmth
description: Feel the plain warmth of gladness in a soul and learn who in reach is pleased.

name: Quiet Hand
description: Lay a quiet hand of soul on one ally and slow the ally's fast breath and pulse.

name: Anger Ease
description: Draw the red heat of rage out of one ally's soul so that thought comes clear again.

name: Mood Chart
description: Chart the moods of a whole room at once and mark who may flare first.
